programme.desc: LeMay, maudit par une prophétie, traque son fils Cal tout en étant poursuivi par des chasseurs de primes.

programme.title: Serieously Ep.39
programme.desc: Ton rendez-vous francophone préféré sur les séries, le cinéma et la pop culture en général!

programme.title: Écran Large Ep.9
programme.desc: Écran Large : actu ciné, séries, comics, jeux vidéo

programme.title: Écran Large Ep.2
programme.desc: Écran Large : actu ciné, séries, comics, jeux vidéo

programme.title: Écran Large Ep.3
programme.desc: Écran Large : actu ciné, séries, comics, jeux vidéo

programme.title: Jamesy Boy
programme.desc: Un jeune délinquant en prison se lie d'amitié avec un meurtrier qui deviendra son mentor.

programme.title: Une nouvelle chance (2016)
programme.desc: Un avenir de jeune chef tendait les bras à Charlie. Pourtant sa vie semble s'être suspendue, habitant avec sa mère et son beau-père et travaillant dans le cinéma de son quartier, Charlie n'a plus de motivation pour rien...

programme.title: The People We Hate at the Wedding
programme.desc: Dans cette comédie hilarante, Alice, Paul et leur mère très optimiste sont invités au mariage de leur demi-sœur, l'occasion pour eux de se retrouver.

programme.title: For Love or Money
programme.desc: Mark a une vie de rêve : il est sur le point de devenir multimillionnaire et d'épouser son amour de jeunesse, Connie. Mais les choses ne sont parfaites qu'en surface : Mark découvre par hasard que Connie ne l'aime pas et compte juste voler sa fortune une fois le mariage prononcé.

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: Malgré un premier rendez-vous désastreux, pour leurs chiens, deux propriétaires sont forcés de se revoir.

programme.title: Le mystère de Noël
programme.desc: L'histoire d'un petit village comme les autres. Mais dans ce petit village, ils ont tendance à avoir une mauvaise mémoire. Ils sont tellement oublieux. Encore et encore. Cette année, ils oublient que c'est l'heure de Noël.

programme.title: Planning for joy (fr)
programme.desc: Alors que Claudia porte la robe de demoiselle d'honneur porte-bonheur qui a permis à toutes ses amies de se marier, elle se rend compte qu'elle cherchait l'amour au mauvais endroit.

programme.title: Marge d'Erreur
programme.desc: Rebecca (Anny Duperey), avocate, réalise que le jeune homme (Julien Crampon) qu'elle a disculpé après une brillante défense pourrait bien être le coupable du meurtre dont il est accusé, et qu'il prépare peut-être un autre crime....

programme.title: Deadly Ruphoria
programme.desc: Une rare soirée entre amies tourne au cauchemar pour Shana Jones, étudiante à l'université, lorsque Romeon Kingston, chef d'un réseau de traite des êtres humains, jette son dévolu sur elle.

programme.title: Kids In America
programme.desc: Un groupe divers d'élèves s'unit pour défier pacifiquement leur principal autoritaire.

programme.title: Bernie le Dauphin: Mission Sauvetage
programme.desc: Un frère et une soeur découvrent sur la plage un dauphin brûlé par le soleil et décident de le soigner. Mais les deux enfans prennent connaissace d'un terrible plan qui pourrait détruire la plage et la maison de leur nouvel ami. Ils vont devoir empêcher ce terrible plan d'être mis à exécution.

programme.title: A Magic Puppy
programme.desc: Adam adore les films d'horreur. C'est une passion qu'il partage avec son amie Molly, qui est secrètement amoureuse de lui. A la suite d'un extraordinaire concours de circonstances, Adam transforme Ted, le petit ami de sa mère, en chien ! Adam et Molly n'auront que quelques jours pour rendre à Ted son aspect initial.

programme.title: Horatio, un Ami Extraordinaire
programme.desc: Depuis que son père est mort, 16 ans, Juliette, sa belle-mère et ses deux demi-frères luttent pour garder leur ranch. Mais Juliette pense qu'elle a un secret qui pourrait garder le ranch ouvert: son cheval, Horatio, peut parler!

programme.title: Les ex de mon mec
programme.desc: Stacy, une jeune journaliste en herbe, découvre, en regardant dans l'organizer électronique de son petit ami, qu'il a eu avant elle une suite de relations sentimentales incroyables avec, entre autres, un superbe mannequin et la voisine de palier. Elle décide de toutes les rencontrer...

programme.title: Multiplicity
programme.desc: Doug Kinney, contremaitre dans une entreprise de construction, est gagne par le stress. Son travail ne lui laisse aucun repit et il a a peine le temps de voir sa femme et ses deux enfants, qu'il adore. Il trouve une solution a tous ces problemes quand il fait la connaissance d'un chercheur en genetique qui lui propose de creer un clone, un autre lui-meme.

programme.title: Tootsie
programme.desc: Michael est un comédien talentueux mais sans travail. Quand sa petite amie, Sandy, rate une audition pour un feuilleton télé, il se travestit en femme et obtient le rôle sous le nom de Dorothy Michaels. Il devient rapidement le confident de Julie, l'actrice avec qui il partage la vedette. Mais il en tombe bientôt amoureux et malheureusement, le père de Julie tombe aussi amoureux... de Dorothy.

programme.title: Mayhem
programme.desc: Un virus se propage dans un cabinet d'avocats le jour où le jeune Derek est piégé par un collègue et injustement licencié, transformant les collaborateurs en bêtes sanguinaires.

programme.title: L'art de la fugue
programme.desc: Antoine vit avec Adar, mais il rêve d'Alexis... Louis est amoureux de Mathilde alors il va épouser Julie... Gérard, qui n'aime qu'Hélène, tombera-t-il dans les bras d'Ariel ? Trois frères en pleine confusion...

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes & John Watson
programme.desc: Les frangins malgré eux se retrouvent. Cette fois, ils interprètent le plus grand détective du monde et son fidèle acolyte et biographe. Will Ferrell et John C. Reilly jouent Holmes et Watson. Ensemble, ils élucident un meurtre à Buckingham Palace.

programme.title: Opération 118 318, sévices clients
programme.desc: Matthieu Polivennes, jeune banquier d'affaires brillant, est envoyé en urgence en Haute-Loire pour redresser le call center de la Cecredico...

programme.title: The Toll
programme.desc: Brendan occupe tout seul un petit poste de péage sur une route secondaire du Pays de Galles. Il est au calme dans cet endroit, ce qui lui permet de dissimuler son passé criminel. Un jour, il est dévalisé par des malfaiteurs maladroits.

programme.title: Le dernier des salauds
programme.desc: Mann est un tireur informé par un ami d'enfance que son père a été assassiné des années plus tôt par sa mère et son amant.

programme.title: Shanghaï Joe
programme.desc: Un immigrant chinois, récemment arrivé en Amérique, se bat pour libérer des esclaves mexicains de leur cruel maître.

programme.title: Les Pistoleros du Nevada
programme.desc: Deux hommes armés arrivent dans une ville avec l'intention de toucher une importante prime, mais se retrouvent pris dans une guerre locale pour le contrôle des terres.

programme.title: Le banni
programme.desc: Les légendes de l'Ouest Pat Garrett, Doc Holliday et Billy the Kid s'affrontent pour la loi et les attentions de la vivace mégère Rio McDonald.

programme.title: La femme qui faillit être lynchée
programme.desc: Pendant la guerre de Sécession, Border City est une ville située à la frontière entre le Missouri et l'Arkansas, au pied des montagnes Ozark.

programme.title: Randy le Solitaire
programme.desc: Emprisonné pour des meurtres qu'il n'a pas commis, Randy s'évade et tombe sur le repaire des vrais meurtriers.

programme.title: On continue à l'appeller Trinita
programme.desc: Bambino essaie d'apprendre à son frère Trinity comment devenir un hors-la-loi, mais ils finissent par sauver une famille de pionniers et à défaire un réseau de contrebande.

programme.title: Hercule contre les tyrans de Babylone
programme.desc: Le roi Shalmaneser, Assur et sa sœur sorcière Tanit, tyrans de Babylone, retiennent prisonniers des Hellènes, dont Esperia, reine d'Hellas. Hercule intervient pour la sauver, punir les tyrans cruels et libérer le peuple.

programme.title: Les Aigles noirs de Santa Fe
programme.desc: Lorsque les Comanches se mettent sur le sentier de la guerre, les colons se réfugient à Fort Eagle Rock, commandé par le capitaine Jackson. L'agent secret Cliff McPherson arrive dans ce fort en sous-effectif pour donner des conseils et apporter son soutien. Il apprend que les Comanches ont été attisés par Morton, un éleveur local qui veut prendre le contrôle du pétrole situé sous la réserve des Indiens.

programme.title: Le temps du massacre
programme.desc: Un chercheur d'or et son demi-frère ivrogne doivent affronter un fermier et son fils sadique après avoir pris le contrôle de sa ferme.

programme.title: Heartless
programme.desc: Jamie Morgan, un jeune homme portant une grande tache de naissance en forme de cœur sur le visage, découvre qu'il y a des démons dans les rues de l'est de Londres.

programme.title: Terreur Sur La Lagune
programme.desc: Le corps d'une jeune fille est retrouvé dans un pré, le meurtrier ne sera pas retrouvé. Des années plus tard, un jeune homme appelé Stefano retourne sur l'île de son enfance pour revoir son frère, le prêtre local...

programme.title: Je Suis Vivant !
programme.desc: A Prague, le corps de Gregory Moore, un journaliste américain, est retrouvé dans un parc. Il est déclaré mort à la morgue, mais il est victime d'une machination. En réalité il a été plongé dans un état de catalepsie et apparaît comme décédé aux yeux de la science. Or, son esprit fonctionne encore.

programme.title: The Blazing World
programme.desc: Des décennies après la noyade accidentelle de sa soeur jumelle, une jeune femme autodestructrice retourne dans sa maison familiale, se retrouvant attirée par une autre dimension où sa soeur est peut-être encore en vie.

programme.title: Sentinel
programme.desc: Des années après qu'une invasion extraterrestre a presque anéanti l'humanité, réfugiés dans une base secrète sur la Lune, trois héros décident de voyager dans le temps dans une tentative désespérée de sauver les survivants. Mais ils ignorent que le Sentinelle les attend.

programme.title: Bounty Killer
programme.desc: Un chasseur de primes débarque dans une petite ville pour récupérer une récompense. Une jeune femme le recrute alors pour régler un problème local.

programme.title: Rottweiler
programme.desc: Laissé pour mort, un chien particulièrement féroce est réanimé et transformé par les laboratoires de l'armée en véritable cyborg.

programme.title: Virtual Revolution
programme.desc: A Paris, en 2047, alors que la population vit connectée en permanence à des mondes virtuels, un agent employé par une multinationale est chargé de traquer des terroristes qui menacent le système.

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: Un groupe de mercenaires est engagé pour secourir une scientifique emprisonnée dans un bunker de la guerre froide. Une fois à l'intérieur du bâtiment, la mission tourne au cauchemar. Ils sont attaqués par une créature terrifiante et mortelle… Nouvel objectif : SURVIVRE !

programme.title: Ainsi va la vie
programme.desc: Lorsqu'il se retrouve soudain en charge de sa petite-fille dont il ignorait l'existence jusqu'à ce que son fils éloigné la dépose chez lui, un agent immobilier égoïste demande l'aide de son voisin.

programme.title: American Animals
programme.desc: Quatre jeunes mettent au point le cambriolage d'une collection de livres inestimables.. Mais à force de s'imaginer comme des héros de cinéma, ils finissent par atteindre le point de non-retour.

programme.title: En ce moment sur Box Office Action
programme.desc: Découvrez les bandes annonces des films à l'affiche sur les chaînes Box Office

programme.title: Reste avec moi
programme.desc: Steffi, 16 ans, vient d'obtenir son diplôme et va partir en voyage avec son copain à Paris. Mais lors d'un bilan médical de routine, les médecins décèlent un cancer incurable : elle n'a plus qu'un an à vivre.

programme.title: Le combat d'une femme
programme.desc: Après avoir été violée, Debbie Smith n'a pas pris la justice en main. Elle a créé sa propre loi.

programme.title: A l'ombre des regards
programme.desc: Holly est une jeune femme qui se laisse dépérir depuis la mort de sa mère jusqu'à ce qu'elle fasse la connaissance de Shane, un champion de MMA déchu.

programme.title: The Son
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un jeune garçon contracte une maladie, une mystérieuse maladie, sa mère doit décider jusqu'où elle ira pour le protéger des forces terrifiantes de son passé.

programme.title: The Body
programme.desc: Un détective recherche le corps d'une femme fatale qui a disparu de la morgue.

programme.title: Au bout du tunnel
programme.desc: Un ingénieur en informatique paraplégique en fauteuil roulant entend des bruits et les voix de braqueurs de banques dans son sous-sol.

programme.title: La Vague
programme.desc: Un professeur de lycée cherche à expliquer à ses élèves ce qu'est la vie sous une dictature. L'expérience tourne mal alors que ses élèves échappent à son contrôle.

programme.title: Spit'n'Split
programme.desc: Une tournée de rock band, c'est des fans prêtes à tomber le tanga pour un autographe, des brouettes de coke et des pluies de billets. Les membres de ce groupe de rock aimeraient confirmer ce mythe. Sauf qu'eux, ce sont des longs trajets dans un van pourri, de l'aspirine et des bars vides.

programme.title: L'Enfer des Zombies
programme.desc: Un navire venu des Antilles accoste au port de New York sans âme qui vive à bord, si ce n'est un zombie qui attaque deux gardes côtes. Avec l'aide d'un journaliste, la fille du propriétaire du bateau décide d'aller enquêter aux Antilles pour retrouver son père. Ils se rendent sur l'île de Matu et y rencontrent le docteur David Menard, qui tente d'inventer un remède contre une maladie qui ramène les morts à la vie, les changeant en zombies cannibales.

programme.title: Scanners II
programme.desc: Un commissaire de police convoite le poste de maire dans sa ville. Pour renforcer la lutte contre la criminalité, il recrute des scanners, êtres dotés de pouvoirs surnaturels leur permettant de s'introduire dans l'esprit des humains.

programme.title: Mantra
programme.desc: Emma et Paul viennent de s'installer dans une banlieue pavillonnaire de province. À peine les cartons défaits, Paul doit aussitôt partir pour un long voyage d'affaires. Dans son bureau, Emma découvre un insecte perché dans un grand vivarium : une mante religieuse. Cette dernière la répugne autant qu'elle la fascine.

programme.title: Uberlinks
programme.desc: Claude et Mahalia ont matché sur une application de rencontre pour personnes dotées de super-pouvoirs. Celui de Claude ? Devenir invisible. Quand Mahalia insiste pour connaître sa première action à la découverte de son pouvoir, Claude fait tout pour fuir la question. De peur de ruiner ses chances avec elle.

programme.title: Scanners III
programme.desc: Héléna et son frère, Alex, sont tous deux des scanners. En proie à de terribles maux de têtes dus à ses pouvoirs, Héléna décide d'absorber une drogue expérimentale mise au point par son père, tandis que son frère se réfugie dans un monastère en Thaïlande. Héléna se transforme alors en véritable machine à tuer. Devenue incontrôlable, elle assassine son père adoptif, libère un groupe de Scanners enfermé dans un hôpital et met au point un plan machiavélique afin de réduire le monde en esclavage.

programme.title: Dementia
programme.desc: Un vétéran atteint de démence découvre que son infirmière cache de terribles secrets.

programme.title: L'Exorcisme de Tamara
programme.desc: Un cambriolage tourne à l'horreur dans une maison.

programme.title: 2025 : Armageddon
programme.desc: Une race extraterrestre militante lance une attaque sur la Terre.

programme.title: Hautes Fréquences
programme.desc: Des gardes du corps sont déployés pour sauver une célébrité sur une île. À leur arrivée, le lieu semble désert…

programme.title: Tuer pour Survivre
programme.desc: Un mercenaire tente de se racheter après avoir été l'homme de main impitoyable d'un syndicat.

programme.title: Undercover Punch And Gun
programme.desc: Un policier d'élite travaille sous couverture pour infiltrer un réseau de drogue et faire traduire en justice le mafieux qui le dirige.

programme.title: The Party Crasher
programme.desc: Sigma Tau, une fraternité étudiante, organise une fête hawaïenne. Rapidement, les jeunes gens réalisent qu'une entité surnaturelle et malveillante a pris possession des lieux.

programme.title: Box Office Action
programme.desc: Découvrez les bandes annonces des films à l'affiche sur les chaînes Box Office

programme.title: La ligne de feu
programme.desc: L'histoire de la résistance héroïque des cadets de Podolsk aux abords de Moscou en octobre 1941.

programme.title: Lady Gun Fighter
programme.desc: 1882, dans une île au sud de la Nouvelle-Zélande, une mère se lance sur les traces du meurtrier de son mari, responsable de l'enlèvement de son fils.

programme.title: Lake Placid : Héritage
programme.desc: De jeunes explorateurs s'aventurent sur un mystérieux lac retiré des cartes modernes, en quêtes de secrets à explorer. Ils y découvrent une île dans laquelle se trouve un laboratoire abandonné, mais s'aperçoivent qu'elle abrite quelque chose de terrifiant : un prédateur des plus mortel. Avant même qu'ils n'aient temps de faire demi-tour, nos aventuriers sont pris au piège. Ils vont rapidement devoir mettre leur rivalité de côté pour réagir ensemble, s'ils veulent avoir la moindre chance de rester en vie…

programme.title: Proud Mary
programme.desc: Mary (Taraji P. Henson), une dangereuse tueuse à gages, travaille pour la famille du crime la plus célèbre de la ville, dirigée par Benny (Danny Glover). Lorsque Mary tue un mafieux sous protection pour sauver un jeune garçon, elle doit faire face à de nombreux criminels de renom, y compris son ancien amant. Armée de son ingéniosité - et d'un placard rempli d'armes - Mary doit faire le nécessaire pour survivre…

programme.title: Anacondas
programme.sub-title: À la poursuite de l'orchidée de sang
programme.desc: Un groupe de scientifiques décide de s'embarquer dans un voyage périlleux à la recherche d'une orchidée très rare qui pourrait détenir un sérum pour préserver la jeunesse. Mais l'expédition s'avère bien plus périlleuse que prévue. De redoutables prédateurs protègent l'orchidée et son terrible secret.

programme.title: LeLagon Bleu
programme.desc: Après que leur bateau se soit échoué, deux jeunes enfants se retrouvent seuls et isolés sur une île déserte. Ils grandissent ensemble et des sentiments commencent à les envahir.

programme.title: Cortex
programme.desc: Voilà des mois que Hagen, un quadra mal dans sa peau, souffre de troubles du sommeil qui renforcent sa paranoïa. Il imagine que sa femme Karoline le trompe. Tout bascule le jour où son épouse a une aventure avec Niko, un jeune voyou.

programme.title: Le Dernier Combat
programme.desc: Hanté par un passé tragique, un boxeur n'ayant jamais perdu un combat, Sailor O'Connor est un homme abattu. Un coup de chance extraordinaire le fait remonter sur le ring.

programme.title: OVNI: Sur la piste extraterrestre
programme.desc: Derek (Alex Sharp), un étudiant d'université brillant hanté par la vue d'un OVNI durant son enfance, croit que les mystérieuses observations signalées dans de nombreux aéroports des États-Unis sont des OVNIS...

programme.desc: Doug Barnes est professeur de mathématiques et joueur invétéré. Cependant le casino le déclare `persona non grata'. L'idée lui vient alors de former une équipe de joueurs qui le remplacera et gagnera à sa place. Il sélectionne trois étudiants brillants et dotés d'une étonnante mémoire visuelle.

programme.title: Masai Mara: The Big Hunt
programme.desc: When food supply in the Serengeti dwindles, the Masai Mara is a paradise for predators. As the black wildebeests, gazelles, zebras and antelopes make their yearly trip from the south of the Serengeti to the north, nature's best laid trap, the Mara River in Kenya is waiting ahead. Captivating shots filmed under water show how crocodiles prepare for the Big Hunt while other predators lurk on the banks awaiting their bounty. The biggest problems for the migratory animals are the Mara and the Tarek River, where they have to put their lives at risk to get to the other side. A great number of them die as they jump into the river and break their legs, while others are carried away by the drift or drown. Those who are not victims of the river itself risk falling prey to the crocodiles. We entered this unchartered territory, the crocodile domain by heading under water. Follow these predators in and around their habitat and watch prides of lions map out their game plan. In slow-motion, we show you the final showdown between predator and prey. Will it be a successful hunt or will the hoofed animals persevere?

programme.title: Penguin City
programme.desc: In the middle of the Antarctic Ocean, an entire mountain range arises from the water: South Georgia, the nursery of the Antarctic. Hundreds of thousands of penguins, elephant seals, fur seals and their young overcrowd the beaches. The rough weather and the extremely difficult access to the island cause filmmaking to be an endeavor requiring much of the film crew around Roland Gockel and Rosie Koch and the state of the art cameras. A lot of patience and sensitivity over a period spanning some five years now offers unknown and poignant insights into the life of the King Penguins on South Georgia Island

programme.title: Over the Islands of Africa
programme.desc: Photographer Matthias Ziegler is an Africa specialist. He has visited nearly every country on the continent on assignments for international agencies. Zanzibar, however, is new territory for him. He's come to the former slave island for a photo book – and this time he's not alone. To see the Tanzanian archipelago from the air, he has enlisted the services of ultralight pilot Richard Meredith-Hardy of England to fly him around in his FIB, or flying inflatable boat. Perfect conditions for an adventurous journey: as a world champion ultralight pilot, Richard and his FIB can take off and land practically anywhere – in theory. (S1 E01)

programme.title: Over the Islands of Africa
programme.desc: Renaud Van Der Meeren is a photographer and paramotor pilot. With his motorised parachute he goes on expeditions to the remotest corners on earth to photograph people and landscapes from the air. Renaud wanted to be a jet pilot, studied music at the Sorbonne, became a ski instructor, model and photographer's assistant before he found happiness in his current vocation. He especially likes to do his job in Mauritius – nowhere else does he find so many motifs as on the "sweetest pearl in the Indian Ocean". This time he's working on a photo book about Mauritius – by land, by water and in the air. (S1 E02)

programme.title: The Atlantic North
programme.desc: From the reedy areas in the Basque Country, via the fantastic world of the Cantabrian mountain range, to Galicia with its spectacular coasts: This is the North Spanish wilderness, which offers unheard of diversity and reveals a hitherto completely unknown side of Spain. In the wetlands during the rutting season, red deer carry out their bitter power struggles until the water around them appears to blister and boil. The Cantabrian mountain range is habitat for around 140 Cantabrian brown bears – Western Europe's greatest bear population. The females wander from place to place in search of food. Adult male bears and steep mountain slopes are a permanent danger for the youngsters. Iridescent blue throats, defending their territorial borders against rivals, appear to observe them. Above the timberline is the Kingdom of the Cantabrian chamois. They share their habitat with the colourful wallcreeper - an extremely rare bird of the tall mountain region. The Asturian fire salamander is the only one of its kind with a complete yellow hue - he hunts his prey on the banks of the countless streams that flow into the Atlantic, which is inhabited by giants from sperm whales to basking sharks, the world's second largest fish. The rugged north has shaped the identity of its inhabitants. The film accompanies a mountain farmer in the Picos de Europa National Park, who still operates traditional livestock farming and a goose barnacle collector on the Costa da Morte, who quite possibly has the world's most dangerous job. Common to both is the fact that neither of them would exchange their homeland for life in the city.

programme.title: Island Magic

programme.title: From Sardinia to Abruzzo
programme.desc: For many people, Sardinia is THE Mediterranean dream island: clichés like crystal-clear water and picturesque coastlines are reality here. Wild horses inhabit the vast unpopulated plateaux of Gesturi. In the adjacent high regions lies the kingdom of the imposing Mouflon. The curved horns of the male come in handy when battling over the females during rutting season. A breathtaking underwater world is hidden beneath the crystal clear water surrounding the island. Colourful fish, corals and sea snails live down here - as well as the basking shark! He can grow up to ten metres long, but he's completely harmless: with his huge mouth he only fishes microorganisms from the water. Sicily, off the coast at the tip of Italy's ‘boot', is the largest island in the Mediterranean. The island's most famous landmark is already visible from far-off: Etna, at 3340 metres the highest active volcano in Europe. Only 40 kilometres away another volcano looms high: Stromboli, which lies in the middle of the sea. It spews lava and fire at virtually minute intervals. From ancient times on, humans have feared the volcanoes of south Italy. Even today, there are 2500 year-old temple grounds still standing on Sicily. These days nature is re-claiming the age-old buildings – Mason bees and lizards inhabit the cracks and crevices, while lush flower meadows surround the ancient pillars. Abruzzo, lying level with Rome, is the wild heart of southern Italy. The rugged, uninhabited mountain world with its unspoilt beech forests make Abruzzo something special: this is Italy from its unfamiliar side! The inaccessible slopes are the territory of the extremely rare Apennine chamois. During rutting, the bucks engage in breakneck chases among the rocks.

programme.title: Detroit

programme.title: Shanghai

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Chef Ryan shares with us how to make Korean fried chicken, a Korean variation of fried chicken that has become incredibly popular across the world. Crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, it is a modern twist to American fried chicken with a sweet and spicy glaze. Pair it with beer or enjoy it as a side dish.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Chef Ryan shares with us how to make cucumber white kimchi, a non-spicy variation of kimchi with a refreshing taste perfect for hot summer weather. A mix of vegetables is used as a stuffing for crunchy cucumber pieces. Freshly made white cucumber kimchi is compared with the fermented one made several days ago.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Chef Ryan shares with us how to make kongguksu, or cold soy milk noodle soup. It is a refreshing noodle dish served in icy-cold soy milk that is especially popular in the summer months. Pine and cashew nuts are added for nuttiness, with julienned cucumber strips for extra texture. Learn how to make this beloved summer delicacy.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: To celebrate chobok, one of the three hottest days of Korean summer, Chef Ryan shares with us how to make fusion samgyetang, a popular dish eaten to beat the heat. It is a hearty dish made by simmering a young chicken stuffed with rice, ginseng, jujubes and other ingredients. Instead of ginseng and licorice, the chef uses more easily available ingredients in Western countries, such as fennel bulb.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Chef Ryan shares with us how to make hobangnip ssambap, or pumpkin leaf wraps with rice. Cooked short grain rice is wrapped in steamed pumpkin leaves, a seasonal ingredient in summer. A savory sauce made of soybean paste and assorted vegetables known as gangdoenjang is added for an extra kick. Stay healthy this summer with this nutritious and delicious recipe.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Chef Ryan shares with us how to make gamja jorim, a popular Korean side dish made with potatoes braised in a soy sauce-based sweet glaze. Made of freshly harvested potatoes, this dish is best enjoyed with a bowl of rice. The potatoes are crispy on the outside while fluffy and soft on the inside.

programme.title: Legendary Places, Ninjago's Most Wanted
programme.desc: Cole joins Jay and Zane inside the Nindroid to solve a mysterious puzzle and also Kai enters Zane's mind and suggests the Ninja take a break from puzzle-solving to figure out which villain is trying to hack their friend.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh?

programme.title: Andrea's Big Moment
programme.desc: When famous pop star Livi comes to Heartlake City to judge a talent show, our five friends Olivia, Mia, Andrea, Emma and Stephanie all decide to enter – and one of them, in particular, really wants to win but faces some serious challenge from an old rival. A talent show has come to Heartlake City and all the girls enter the talent competition hoping to impress the judges, especially their idol, pop star Chloe. No one wants a shot at stardom more than Andrea, which is why the other girls are surprised when she doesn't show up to practice before the first round of the competition. Very nearly eliminated prior to the big show, Andrea panics and throws herself into an intense practice-training mode, even shutting her friends out when they're trying to help her with her performance. Just moments before her live TV debut, Andrea realizes she's missing a key element to her act. Can she pull it off without her friends? And are the other girls willing to help after being pushed away?

programme.title: Kate's Island
programme.desc: The five friends leave for science camp that takes place on an island and during the trip, they meet the stand-offish Kate – but they soon realize that there's more to her than meets the eyes and that you shouldn't judge the book by its cover. No one is more excited than Olivia about science camp at a beautiful rocky offshore island with a lighthouse. But Olivia quickly gets off on the wrong foot with a mysterious girl named Kate who seems obsessed with a medallion necklace and the island's rumored history of pirates and treasure. Even worse for Olivia, Kate seems to be growing extra chummy with Mia, even sneaking around the island with her late at night. With the help of Stephanie, Emma and Andrea, Olivia is determined to get to the bottom of the girls' secret friendship and find out once and for all what they're searching for on the island, but they better not let Mrs. Stevens catch them out of their cabin past curfew.

programme.title: The Grand Hotel
programme.desc: The five friends help out at The Grand Hotel that Andrea's family just bought during what was supposed to be a quiet weekend until a hotel critic arrives unexpectedly. The girls are ready to do everything to make a great impression – but things don't quite go according to plan. Andrea, Stephanie, Olivia, Emma and Mia have come for breakfast at the fanciest hotel in town, now owned by Andrea's family. When Andrea's aunt has to leave town, the girls volunteer to run the hotel for the weekend with the help of quirky Grandma Jean. This is the perfect job for Stephanie's expert managerial skills but then the hotel suddenly fills to capacity with guests, including a hotel critic that can make or break the hotel's reputation! Now the girls find themselves in over their heads juggling reception, childcare, food prep and waitressing, a dog-walking service and a testy chef who quits on them in the middle of dinner. Unfortunately, much of this is their own fault. Can the girls save the Grand Hotel from themselves?

programme.title: Ninjaball Run
programme.desc: When the ninja learn that Darreth's Mojo Dojo is to be destroyed and Darreth doesn't have the money to save it, our heroes enter the annual NinjaBall Run to win its cash prize in order to save the dojo. As Lloyd continues to train and unlock his hidden powers, the Ninja learn land developers are going to destroy Darreth's Mojo Dojo unless Darreth can find the money to save it. The Ninja decide to enter their Ninja Tank into the annual NinjaBall Run cross-country rally to try to win its cash prize. Revisiting past characters who also enter the race, the high-speed derby will only grow more dangerous as Garmadon enters his Black Bounty, realizing this is the perfect chance to use his Mega-Weapon and rid the ninja. In the end, the Ninja will discover a few secrets within their Ninja Tank, allowing them to beat Garmadon's Bounty by a millisecond and saving Darreth's Dojo with their well-deserved cash prize. And as a final surprise, the Ninja steal back the Destiny's Bounty and make it their own once again.

programme.title: Child's Play
programme.desc: When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and turned into kids and are now forced to enlist Lloyd's help to battle the awakened monster. Tired of intense training, Lloyd yearns to play and enjoy his youth. The Ninja remind Lloyd that along with great power, comes great responsibility. When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and soon discover they've been turned into kids! Seeking Lloyd's help and relying on childhood antics, the five ninja kids must destroy the reawakened monster that's hunting them in the city. In the end, Lloyd makes the difficult decision and sacrifices his youth in order to save them from the beast, turning forward the clock and turning Lloyd into a young man. Sensei Wu fears now that since Lloyd is young man, the final battle of good versus evil approaches sooner than he had ever expected.

programme.title: The Surge
programme.desc: After a time of peace, the Ninja are called back into action. The spirit of the defeated Overlord has infected the electric grid of Ninjago and is using all available technology to exact his revenge on Lloyd. Nowhere is safe but fortunately, the Ninja have been given the powerful Techno Blades. But the only problem is that they have no idea how to use them. Time has passed since the Ultimate Battle, and while the Golden Ninja continues to watch over Ninjago, the other Ninja have become complacent as schoolteachers. When a mysterious invitation from genius Cyrus Borg brings them to the futuristic New Ninjago City, trouble surges when a digital virus of the Overlord takes over technology. The Golden Ninja makes a heroic entrance, only to find out his Golden Power supercharges the enemy. Sensei Wu stays behind so that the Ninja can escape with the only thing that can save Ninjago's future – Borg's Techno Weapons.

programme.title: The Art Of The Silent Fist
programme.desc: The Ninja go into hiding but an army of the Digtial Overlord's evil robotic Nindroids are hunting them wherever they go. Their only chance is to learn the secrets of the Techno blades and use them to cut all power to save Ninjao from this technological menace. The Ninja hide out at a safe place void of technology – Sensei Garmadon's Sanctuary. That night, Zane is visited by Borg's female robo-assistant, Pixal. She warns them that the Digital Overlord is after Lloyd's Golden Power in order to become flesh, but the Techno Blades can reboot the system and erase him for good. After a highly advanced army of Nindroids attacks the Sanctuary, Lloyd flees with his father into the wilderness of Ninjago, while the rest set off on a quest to turn off all power in Ninjago, so that they can erase the Digital Overlord once and for all.

programme.title: The Book Of Total Badness
programme.desc: The NEXO-Knights must fight Jestro's Monsters of Destruction which are attacking all over the Kingdom. But Merlok smells a trap…is he right? In a dark, destroyed part of the kingdom, Jestro arrives at the ruins of a HUGE castle. The Book of Monsters knows this place: the great evil wizard Monstrux lived here. The Book sniffs out some powerful magic in the ruins: “The Book of Destruction.” With this, The Book tells Jestro they can destroy the NEXO-Knights and then attack the King's Castle and cause massive destruction. Jestro creates destructive monsters and sends them all over the realm, so the Knights must separate and fight single combats all over the place. The Knights lose these battles (lesson: they have to work as a team!) And, just when the Knights are scattered across the Kingdom, Jestro attacks the King's Castle! It looks like all is lost. When Aaron, who has escaped, returns to see Jestro's attack, he realizes he must gather his fellow Knights. Merlok says it's very dangerous, but Aaron says he must take the risk to gather the Knights and save Knighton.

programme.title: The Might And The Magic
programme.desc: Aaron races across the kingdom to gather the NEXO-Knights as Jestro and his Destructive Monsters attack the King's Castle. The Knights must get back to the capitol in time, or Jestro will rule the kingdom! Jestro, while still attacking the King's Castle, has second thoughts until the Book of Monsters orders the mad jester to feed him another magic book he's found (and has been saving.) It's the powerful “Book of Revenge!” Now, combining the powers of Revenge and Destruction, Jestro and his monsters will get their vengeance on King Halbert and the Kingdom of Knighton. Jestro and his monsters lay siege…will they destroy the castle?! Meanwhile, Aaron races across the Kingdom gathering the NEXO-Knights one at a time. As each Knight rejoins the group, they become a more and more powerful team. They even get Robin to join them as the Black Knight in his repaired power suit. Our Knights arrive, finally regrouped, fight off Jestro, save the castle and the King. It's a glorious victory! The King is so pleased after seeing how the brave NEXO-Knights saved his kingdom, he allows Macy to join them as an official NEXO-Knight.

programme.title: Back To School
programme.desc: When the NEXO-Knights are sloppy in a fight with Jestro, Merlok 2.0 sends them back to the Knights' Academy. Not only for a brush-up but to find out what Jestro is after in its hallowed halls. As they Knights battle Jestro – in a somewhat haphazard and lazy way – they discuss the fact that Jestro never wins and that they're always getting over on him. Despite defeating the jerky Jester and his evil Book, Merlok 2.0 discovers that something about the attack on the village is tied to the Knights' Academy. It looks like that's where they'll strike next. It wouldn't hurt for the Knights to go “back to school” to watch for Jestro and for some refresher training. Merlok is sure Jestro wants something at the Academy, but he doesn't know what it is. The Knights are very much “fish out of water” at the academy, even with the “cool kids” – Robin and Ava – showing them around. The next generation of Knights is being taught to integrate the NEXO-Magic of Merlok into their fighting techniques and these kids are good (so good, they initially kick the lazy, know-it-all Knight's butts!) Their old principal, the ever-ornery Headmaster Brickland, sets them straight: they're all still slackers, and they better get their acts together (especially Lance!) The Knights take shifts as “library helpers” much to the delight of the old squirebot librarian, MARGE. They're convinced Jestro is after a book…isn't he always after a book? When Jestro attacks, the Knights help organize the students and there's a big fight in the Academy Library versus Jestro and his Monsters. They drive Jestro off without letting him steal any books! Victory! But as Jestro leaves, we see him holding what the Book of Monsters really wanted: a snow globe with a castle in it that was sitting on the librarian's desk. In the Lava Lands, Jestro throws the snow globe into a volcano and it frees the massive Castle of Monstrux from its snowy magic prison

programme.title: Greed Is Good?
programme.desc: When Jestro uses the Book of Greed to rob Auremville of its riches, he also gets Lance's parents as prisoners and these demanding rich folks are too much for even monsters to handle. Jestro's not sure what to do with his new castle in the Lava Lands. “Every castle needs a big chamber filled with treasure” says the Book of Monsters so they've got to go out looting! The BOM convinces Jestro to call forth GENERAL MAGMAR, and Jestro appoints him as “general manager” of “castle operations,” much to Magmar's dismay. Meanwhile, Jestro and the BOM find the BOOK OF GREED. This will allow them to make greedy, rapacious monsters that will bring them all the treasure they want to fill their castle! They'll head to the richest town in the realm – AUREMVILLE! Meanwhile, in Auremville, the NEXO-Knights arrive for a huge “Gold is Good” ball at Lance's house. When the Monsters finally arrive in Auremville, a battle breaks out and the greedy monsters make off with everything…including Lance's parents, Goldie and Cuthbert Richmond who are clad in the finest golden garments and so look valuable! Lance will now be forced to live…poor. The Knights have to get his parents back. Meanwhile, his parents – Cuthbert and Goldie Richmond –think their imprisonment in Jestro's gold-filled castle is a “spa holiday” with the worst service. They order Magmar and the monsters around like servants and drive them all crazy. The Knights pile into the Fortrex and head for the Lava Lands, formulating a plan along the way to free Lance's parents. In a village half-way to Jestro's Castle, the Knights run into…Jestro and his monsters headed the other way with Lance's parents and all the gold they've stolen. There's a big fight, until they realize they might have the same goal and decide to deal. The BOM wants to give them back all the gold and Lance's parents. Lance says “No deal.” “We'll take the gold, you can keep my parents.” It's a weird and comical stand-off. Finally, Clay convinces Lance he has to take his parents back even if they don't always get along (and, it's the only way to get the gold back.)

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - No Smurf Is An Island: Handy Smurf is the one who fixes everything that needs mending in the Village of the Smurfs. But are his efforts really appreciated by the other Smurfs? Not at all. At least this is what Handy feels when he resolves to leave the Smurfs Village forever and live in the sea with Marina the Mermaid...

programme.title: Farmer's Genie
programme.desc: As Farmer Smurf says, what's a gourd doing in the melon patch, when it should be by the rutabagas? But when Farmer Smurf pulls the gourd out of the ground he frees a genie, which calls him Master and insists on granting him wishes. The genie, called Gourdy, is going to be more of a hindrance than a help in his eagerness to please Farmer Smurf.

programme.title: Poet's Writers' Block
programme.desc: The Smurfs want a poem written for each of them. The pressure overwhelms Poet, so he runs away seeking inspiration. The Wilybeast King captures Poet and forces him to write a poem to cheer up the King's daughter. Poet learns that motivation must come from the heart and cannot be forced.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Crooner Smurf: Harmony Smurf is no longer wanted in the Smurf Choir: his singing is too far off-key. But Papa Smurf gives him an amulet that will make him a vocal virtuoso. Now here comes Hogatha...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Baby Smurf Is Missing: Thinking Baby Smurf is a leprechaun, two poachers kidnap him and try to get the small one to tell them where his pot of gold is hidden. Papa Smurf organizes everyone to attack the villains with Smurfberry pies so Baby can escape.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Smurfing Out Of Time: None of the Smurfs seem to have time to play with the Smurflings. They go on a visit to Father Time and come across the River of Time, the great current that flows along majestically, carrying with it all the time in the world. And then an accident occurs, with untimely consequences...

programme.title: Tailor's Magic Needle
programme.desc: Tailor Smurf has to make an outfit for every Smurf before the Fall fashion show. Brainy Smurf wants to help him and, using Papa Smurf's book of Magic, he conjures up a magic needle that sews ten times faster than tailor... But is it really any good?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Memory Melon: Selwyn and Tallulah are two powerful married wizards. The trouble is, they fight all the time. But the energy from their arguments is brewing up a dreadful storm and Papa has to get them to make up before the storm starts to rage.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - A Smurf For Denisa: Balthazar brings Denisa to Gargamel to baby-sit. But Gargamel loses Denisa in the wood and she and Sassette meet and become friends. Sassette and Denisa work together to free the Smurfs from Gargamel's stewpot, and prove you don't have to be big to be brave.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Peewit's Unscrupulous Adventure: Peewit, the court jester, is the Smurfs' human friend. There is to be a celebration at the King's castle and Peewit good-humouredly invites his little blue friends to the feast. But they learn that the wicked chamberlain is pilfering the King's possessions.

programme.title: The Smurfiest Of Friends
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf had one friend: Clumsy Smurf. But poor Clumsy is so, well, clumsy, that Brainy refuses to see him again. So now he is left without anyone willing to listen to him. Maybe Buddy, the good-looking imp met by chance near the Great Oak can be a pal for Brainy....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Poltersmurf: There are few things Grandpa Smurf enjoys more than telling a good scary story, and there are few Smurfs who don't love to listen. But things get a little too much for Brainy Smurf when Grandpa tells of Poltersmurfs, and Poltersmurfs begin harrowing Brainy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Greedy And The Porridge Pot: The good fairy, Guinilda gives Greedy a magic porridge pot that Brainy causes to overflow into the village and forest. The good-hearted fairy hurries to the rescue and then asks for the pot back to give to an orphanage of hungry children.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Most Unsmurfy Games: To prove the worth of his Big Book of Wilderness Survival, Brainy takes the Smurflings to the swamp. Where, thanks to his expert advice, the tiny group gets totally lost, is then caught in quicklime and trapped by King Bullrush of the Wartmongers. Fortunately, Bullrush is in a playful mood and devises a Smurf hunt. Unfortunately, Brainy believes he is a born leader...

programme.title: Smurf Box Derby
programme.desc: Handy Smurf makes another invention: the Smurfmobile. Each Smurf has his – or her – customized vehicle and all, or almost all, the Smurfs enjoy a little spin... But then the evil wizard Gargamel gets hold of the idea and starts making trouble for the Smurfs...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Noble Stag: His wicked cousin, Malcolm the Mean, who plans to kill him and mount him in his trophy room, has turned King Gerard into a black stag. The little Smurfs help their friend. When King Gerard is transformed back into his human form, Malcolm becomes imprisoned in the body of the stag.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Curried Smurfs: In Ancient India, the unscrupulous fakir Gargapuri sells the Smurfs to the Rajah for his private zoo. Only Grandpa, Wild Smurf and Jokey are free, so it's up to them to sneak into the palace and rescue their friends. Along the way they free all the caged animals in the Raja's menagerie.

programme.title: The Smurfs

programme.title: The Smurfs

Papa Smurf outwits the wicked wizard with some of his own magic and Gargamel is chased down the mountain and back to his castle.

programme.title: The Smurfs

When he confronts the pokies' enemies, the Norfnags, he finds they aren't fearful at all. Dreamy bumps his head and wakes up to discover it was just a dream, yet finds a jewel in his cap, just like the ones the pokies mine for a living.

programme.title: The Tops and the Roots
programme.desc: There was a village and a man, living in this village. In a deep forest near that village, the Bear settled in. The Bear asked the man for some tasty treats. The man gave the Bear two options of what he prefers to eat: the tops or the roots. The Bear decided to take the tops. The man grew a turnip and gave the tops to the Bear. The tops were tasteless. The Bear asked the man to try the turnip. The man agreed on the condition that the Bear will help him with the housework and keep off the flies. While chasing away the flies, the Bear accidentally hit the man on the nose. The Bear was scared and ran away into the forest, grabbing the turnip with him. Since then, people use to say “to be a fool for one's pains”.

Once upon a time Ali-Baba overheard the magic spell, which opens up the magic cape with numerous treasures. These treasures were stolen by the thieves and kept in this cave. One day Ali-Baba met Kasym and told him the secret spell. Kasym got inside the cape, but accidentally forgot the spell and the thieves caught him. They forced Kasym to learn the whole book of fairy tales by heart and spend one thousand days and a thousand and one nights telling these stories to them. This story teaches us to study well and avoid cheating.

programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Wee Little Havroshechka
programme.desc: There lived a woman who had three daughters - two of her own and the stepdaughter called Wee Little Havroshechka. She loved her own daughters and hated the stepdaughter who was forced to work till dawn. No matter how hard she tried to please the stepmother, she was unapproachable. Once upon a time the stepmother kicked her out of the house, but every medal has its flipside – Wee Little Havroshechka met her Prince and they lived happily ever after, and it's all because she was hard-working and clean.

And most importantly, music will unite everyone!

Or maybe each system has a certain order?

programme.title: Fishy story
programme.desc: Summer is a time of rest and miracles. How nice is just to sit on the river bank with your best friends! However, everything is not so simple in our story. The Bear didn't even suspect what kind of adventure he was going to find on his fishing trip. While Masha and She-Bear frightened by his sudden disappearance, explore the neighborhood, he ... however, you will find out everything yourself in our new episode.

programme.desc: The autumn has arrived. The Bear prepares for his winter bedtime by barricading himself from Masha inside the house. But the little girl manages to find her way indoors and causes yet another mess by awakening a whole swarm of bees. But all her games eventually stop and when the Bear cooks some porridge to feed the child, he discovers her fallen asleep.

programme.title: A Ghost Story
programme.desc: At first time in her life Masha is frightened in earnest, however this creepy story shook up the whole forest and now hardly anyone can stay away from these strange scenes! And what would you do if your own pillow and blanket turn into real ghosts?! A real ghost story, oh yeah!

programme.desc: Masha loves fairy tales and of course she believes that each fairy tale should lead to happy end, even if nothing contributes to it! That's how the story goes… The Bear still hopes to win the heart of the female Bear. He finds an ancient gondola at the bottom of the forest lake. The Bear decides to restore it and invites the female Bear for a romantic ride! No one would have expected that this story would perfectly match Masha's new hobby - puppet theatre.

programme.title: Time To Ride My Pony
programme.desc: The Bear's good friend, the Tiger, is back for a visit and they decide to spend the time together in an intellectual way – playing chess. Masha is immediately drawn into the game and to everyone's surprise, she outsmarts and outplays both the Bear and his friend with just one chess figure.

programme.desc: The bear finds a beautiful black piano in the forest. He happily takes it home, fixes and tunes it and begins to play some music. Finally the Bear figures out that the penguin will be happy only in suitable weather conditions and send the penguin Antarctica on a little plane.

programme.title: See You Later
programme.desc: This day will change Bear's life forever. To everyone's surprise, Masha has suddenly grown up, getting all the forest dwellers shocked by her exceptionally good behavior. Her sister Dasha is going to take her back to the big city, which really upsets the Bear and others.

Only on the ground everything is arranged differently than at home. Masha and Mishka will help them to understand what's what, fix the ship and go back to home.

The bug suffered a lot until he realized that all tiny things you see in the dark just seem to be frightful and fear makes no sense at all!

programme.title: Terrible Truth About Those Who Are Afraid To Be Little

programme.title: Sinister Saga Of A Sick Tummy And A Girl Who Was Afraid Of Doctors
programme.desc: Masha narrates a terrific story about one little girl who was afraid of doctors. And once upon a time she experienced one fantastic story…she decided to cook dinner for her dolls. She took some clay and made “meat balls” with “semolina porridge”. As the meal seemed tasty, Sima decided to eat a bit of her dinner too… And so she lies in her bad and feels a horrible stomachache. Nobody knows how long she would need to suffer, but when she woke up…she realized herself in hospital…near the real snow queen… who explained that medical treatment is not scary at all…though some other things are very fearsome! Oh yeah!

programme.title: Bloodcurdling Saga About Joyful Event
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Grim Parable About Superstitious Girl
programme.desc: Some people happen to believe in all sorts of omens like black cats, wearing clothes inside out, prophetic dreams… Poor girl Lucy believed in that kind of stuff so much that was even afraid to go outside to play with her friends. And how could you go out if you were born in the year of Purple rabbit that promises…no matter what… You'll see…

programme.title: Terrifying True Story About Monsters And Those Who Fear Them
programme.desc: Are you afraid of monsters? Sure you are! Let me tell you a scary story about a boy who experienced a real fear…This story happened on an abandoned tractor factory. The boy lost a scoop from his toy-tractor and decided to look for it at the factory. So he goes up the stairs and sees a large female monster, who was about to paint her lips with a roller! As he kept walking he noticed more monsters playing domino! The boy was very terrified and about to cry, when he learnt that it was just a movie set and all the monsters were not real! They were just actors…Finally the boy realized that all the monsters from the books and movies are not real at all! But if want to see a real monster- watch a fly under a microscope!

programme.title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids

Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.desc: Cheol-su, a clumsy high schooler who acts like a tough hoodlum, ends up spending "exactly one night" with Ae-ran, whose specialty is putting out cigarettes with her mouth. He hears nothing from Ae-ran after that night until nearly a year later, when a basket is delivered to his classroom via quick service. Inside the basket is a newborn baby. As it turns out, Ae-ran had conceived Cheol-su's child that night and gave birth in a high school restroom. Cheol-su visits Ae-ran's friend, Sun-mi, to ask about her whereabouts, only to turn away after hearing she left to study in the United States. Kicked out of school due to the "baby basket delivery incident," Cheol-su begins raising his son, Cho-won, while working as a show MC at an adult nightclub. Leaving the baby with his colleagues like a modern-day beggar-father, Cheol-su names the boy "Cho-won" after the name of the motel where he spent that first night with Ae-ran. “Baby delivery!” A baby in a basket is delivered to a classroom, and a high schooler suddenly becomes a father. As Cho-won grows up frequenting the clubs with his father, he bonds with characters like the drag show's Bo-ri-su and Elena Kim, as well as the club hostesses, maturing into a precocious and cheerful child. By absorbing the real-world slang of these fringe characters, he gains a natural vocabulary far beyond his peers and occasionally predicts the future by reading "Hwatu" cards, a skill even some adults lack. Time passes, and Cho-won turns seven. Then, Ae-ran returns from the U.S. as the direct superior of Cheol-su's former classmate and underwear designer, Jeol-gu. Haunted by the guilt of abandoning her baby, Ae-ran longs to see Cho-won and lingers by his side without revealing that she is his mother. Cho-won, believing his mother is dead, follows Ae-ran, thinking of her as a kind lady, while Cheol-su grows anxious that the child might be taken away. Eventually, Cheol-su tries to leave for a club in the countryside with Cho-won, but a minor incident pulls them into a massive ordeal...

Through this live broadcast, GTC Punjabi Television connects Sangat across the globe to the serene atmosphere of the Gurudwara, allowing viewers to immerse themselves in Naam Simran, Shabad Kirtan, and the timeless wisdom of Gurbani. The soulful renditions inspire inner calm, strengthen spiritual connection, and spread the universal message of love, equality, and humility as taught by the Sikh Gurus.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA

Instead of ginseng and licorice, the chef uses more easily available ingredients in Western countries, such as fennel bulb.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.desc: With the luxury saloon EQS and the sporty executive saloon EQE, Mercedes-Benz has entered a new, all-electric era in the upper market segments as well. Thanks to powerful electric motors, responsive 4MATIC all-wheel drive and an intelligent OFFROAD driving mode, the EQS SUV is also capable of tackling light terrain with ease. The new EQS SUV shares the long wheelbase (3210 millimetres) with the EQS Saloon, but is over 20 centimetres higher. The dimensions in detail: 5125/1959/1718 millimetres (length/width/height). programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.title: Epic Southern Road Trip
programme.desc: The next stop on Sorted Food's Epic Southern Road Trip is Savannah, Georgia. In 48 hours they must learn all they can about local culture and cuisine before hosting a dinner party for local chefs to showcase what they've learned about Southern food and hospitality. Will the guys be able to learn enough in such a short period of time?

programme.title: Epic Southern Road Trip
programme.desc: After exploring Savannah, Georgia for 48 hours learning the ropes of Southern food and hospitality, Chef Ben, Jamie and Mike try hosting a dinner party for local chefs, food writers and Savannah natives. How will these expectant locals react?

programme.title: Sorted Food: Game Changers

programme.title: Epic Trails: Backpacking West Virginia

programme.title: One Perfect Day in Kentucky
programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF's Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly's ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky's own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly's horse wins the race. At Louisville's Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.title: Adventure Cities
programme.desc: Jonathan Thompson explores the adventurous side of St. Petersburg Clearwater, Florida Charleston, South Carolina and Juneau, Alaska.

programme.title: America's Musical Journey

programme.title: USA Through Film 2
programme.desc: Actor and director Jordan Spiro (Ozark, Night Comes On) spent childhood vacations with her family in New Orleans. For Spiro, the city's heritage as the birthplace of jazz is reflected in its mélange of arts and food culture that always feels fresh, inviting, and joyous, even after a lifetime of visits. “There's this ‘all senses on overload' side to New Orleans that takes my breath away every time.”
